terms: sistema de informação para a saúde

sub_indicators.label: Health information system
sub_indicators.subject: dpi.mis
sub_indicators.norm_short: The Africa CDC Digital Transformation Strategy asks for national digital health systems strengthened to its Health Information Exchange Guidelines, with integrated surveillance.
criteria: A source from the past three years says health reporting is on paper and there is no national health information system.
The health ministry procured, piloted or is rolling out a health management information system, or one is in use in some districts.
A national health management information system is in service, with facilities or districts across the country reporting through it.
The system is linked to, or exchanges data with, disease surveillance, the medicines supply chain, or a patient or immunisation register.
The reporting completeness or timeliness of the national system is published.
